name: dobe_pose_lick
desc: Change only two things: 1) remove the tail completely (the goo tail behind the right arm), fill that area with the background; 2) make the Doberman lick its lips: a pink tongue sticks out from the corner of its grinning mouth and licks the upper lip, with a lewd sly grin, half-lidded yellow eyes looking at the raised hand. Keep everything else exactly the same: the raised sticky hand, body, pose, colors, marble streaks, outline and pixel art style. No line between the nose and the mouth.
